about: Hand-judged statements for tools/decode_eval.py. rows = decoder rows a team should land on (any of them counts as a hit); [] = nonsense control that must return no row. row_names pins each referenced row number to the start of its problem-statement cell, so a renumbering fails loudly while appended rows change nothing. split: train statements were used to calibrate DECODE_FLOOR and the matching; holdout statements were written at the same time and not looked at during tuning. The breadth-regression split was written before the 2026-11-07 decoder changes; it is reported separately from the original, unchanged train/holdout cases. no_runnable_starter requires the best row to disclose the absence of a runnable matching sample.
